item.title: [The Crucible] Convolution and Sampling in Fourier and Laplace
item.description: Unveiling the mathematical symmetry between Time and Frequency domains. A deep dive into why multiplication in one domain equals convolution in the other, and the mystery of spectrum replication.

item.title: [The Crucible] RLC Circuit Analysis: Differential Equations vs. Laplace Transform
item.description: Reflecting on the two distinct mathematical approaches to circuit analysis. Why do we shift from the tangible time domain to the abstract s-domain? A journey through the mathematical machinery of RLC circuits.
